title: Fuzzy Topic Modeling with Learnable Thresholds for Aspect Personalized Video Recommendation
problem: Fixed rating thresholds ignore personal rating habits, and discrete ratings miss preference intensity.
architecture: DynaFuzz-DLDA: LDA over user comments with an aspect-term association graph corpus (tags linked to comment keywords); improved association-rule sampling for imbalance; fuzzy LDA (FLDA) on probabilised ratings for user-interest features; MLP that learns a per-user recommendation threshold.
key_results: Cold start: F1 0.9420 / 0.7899 / 0.7959 on ml-25m / ml-20m / ml-latest; TextCNN is slightly higher on ml-25m (0.9439).
Average cold-start scores reported as 0.8426 (F1), 0.7647 (accuracy) and 1.0359 (RMSE).
strengths: Combines topic modelling with fuzzy ratings and learned thresholds for personalisation.

limitations.text: Not peer reviewed at the time of reading; VAEARM obtains much lower RMSE (e.g. 0.3268 vs 0.6230 on ml-25m).
No topic-quality evaluation; topic modelling is one component of a recommender.

notes: Bibliographic metadata listed Knowledge and Information Systems; the read copy is the Research Square preprint, so it is cited as a preprint.
